docTitle.zh: 随心字幕 AI (AI-SRTSub) - 全球好剧随心看，一键生成专属母语字幕
docTitle.en: AI-SRTSub - Global Movies & Series, Subtitles in Your Language

footer.zh: 随心字幕 AI · 开源 AGPL-3.0 · 你的字幕永远属于你
footer.en: AI-SRTSub · Open source AGPL-3.0 · Your subtitles always belong to you

rule1.zh: ① 翻译风格可选（均衡/口语自然/自定义）

rule4.zh: ④ 专名可保留或翻译
rule4.en: ④ Keep or translate proper nouns

rule6.zh: ⑥ 超过行宽阈值自动折行
rule6.en: ⑥ Auto-wrap lines over the width threshold

pastePh.zh: 或直接把字幕文本粘贴到这里…（支持 SRT / VTT / ASS）
pastePh.en: …or paste subtitle text here… (SRT / VTT / ASS)

dropTitle.zh: 点这里选文件，或直接拖进来 🎬
dropTitle.en: Click to choose a file, or just drag it here 🎬

dropSub.zh: SRT · VTT · ASS · TXT · 100 种语言互译

altDemo.zh: 载入示例，先逛逛工作台 →
altDemo.en: Load a sample & explore the studio →

enterHint.zh: 上传后自动进入字幕工作台——语言、风格、导出样式都在那里配置
enterHint.en: After upload you will land in the subtitle studio — language, style and export options all live there

optBuiltin.zh: 默认模型（站点提供，无需 Key）

optDemo.zh: 规则演练（无翻译，仅演示折行/水词/重排）

builtinOn.zh: 默认模型已就绪：{0}。开箱即用；单 IP 每日限 {1} 次请求，大批量建议用自己的 API。
builtinOn.en: Default model ready: {0}. Works out of the box; {1} requests per IP per day — for large files prefer your own API.

builtinOff.zh: 管理员尚未配置默认模型，当前不可用 → 请改用「自定义 API」或「规则演练」。
builtinOff.en: The admin has not configured a default model yet → please use "Custom API" or "Dry run".

lblSrcLang.zh: 源字幕语言（选“自动检测”则让模型识别）
lblSrcLang.en: Source language ("Auto-detect" lets the model decide)

styleCustomPh.zh: 描述你想要的口吻，如：轻松幽默、像给朋友讲故事
styleCustomPh.en: Describe the tone you want, e.g. light-hearted, like telling a story to a friend

hintElegant.zh: 均衡：准确传达原意、通顺流畅、用词得体，贴合目标语言表达习惯。
hintElegant.en: Balanced: accurate, fluent and graceful, following the target language's natural expression.

hintPlain.zh: 口语自然：口语化、直白易懂，像日常对话；多用短句与常用词，保留说话人语气。
hintPlain.en: Natural & conversational: colloquial and easy to understand, like everyday conversation; short sentences, common words, keep the speaker's tone.

hintCustom.zh: 自定义：下面的描述将原样作为“翻译风格”要求发给模型。
hintCustom.en: Custom: the description below is sent to the model verbatim as the style requirement.

batchTip.zh: 每次请求送模型的字幕字符数。按长度自动分批——短句多装、长句少装，每批输出量稳定。越大总耗时略短，但过大可能降低翻译质量；默认 3000 适合大多数视频。
batchTip.en: Characters of subtitles sent to the model per request. Batches are cut by length automatically: short lines fill more, long lines fewer, keeping each output stable. Larger values finish slightly faster, but too large may reduce quality; the default 3000 suits most videos.

lblKey.zh: API Key（仅保存在本机浏览器）
lblKey.en: API Key (stored only in this browser)

tempTip.zh: 与后台模型设置的「温度」同一含义：越小越稳定、越大越发散；字幕翻译建议 0.2 或更低。留空则按 0.2。
tempTip.en: Same field as Temperature in the admin model settings: lower is steadier, higher is more varied. For subtitles 0.2 or lower is recommended; leave empty for 0.2.

errCors.zh: 浏览器直连被拒绝（该端点多半不允许跨域，或本机网络不通）。可勾选「由本站服务器转发」再试。
errCors.en: Direct browser connection refused (the endpoint usually disallows cross-origin calls, or your network cannot reach it). Tick "Relay through this site" and retry.

noteDeepSeek.zh: 推荐：性价比高、速度快，适合字幕批量翻译
noteDeepSeek.en: Recommended: fast and cost-effective, ideal for batch subtitle translation

chkKeepTerms.zh: 专有名词（人名/机构/产品/术语）保留原文，不翻译

lblTerms.zh: 统一译名（术语表，每行一条）

termsPh.zh: 每行一条：原文 → 译法；只写原文表示保留原文
termsPh.en: One per line: source → rendering; a line with only the source term keeps the original

chkAutoTerms.zh: 自动术语表：翻译前自动提取专名与歧义词，统一全片译法
chkAutoTerms.en: Auto glossary: extract proper nouns & ambiguous terms before translating for file-wide consistency

lblMaxW.zh: 折行宽度（单位=全角宽，不是字数：1 个汉字/假名/韩文音节=1；拉丁·西里尔·泰文·阿拉伯字母=0.5，即半角文字 1 单位≈2 字符）。作用于单语折行，以及双语的「- A - B」双说话人行。默认随目标语言按 Netflix 规范推荐（中/韩 16、日 13、其余 21）。调大 → 一行更长、行数和切分更少。
lblMaxW.en: Single-language width in full-width UNITS, not characters: 1 CJK char = 1; Latin, Cyrillic, Thai and Arabic letters = 0.5, so 1 unit is about 2 characters for half-width scripts. Governs monolingual wrapping and "- A - B" dual-speaker lines in bilingual export. Default follows the Netflix spec per language (zh/ko 16, ja 13, others 21). Larger = longer lines, fewer line breaks and cue splits.

lblBiMaxW.zh: 双语导出时【译文行】的宽度上限（同为全角宽单位，不是字数：同样 32，中文≈32 字，泰文≈64 字符）。只约束译文行，源文行跟随语义断点、不限宽；双说话人行走上方「单语行宽」。只有译文超出才拆时间轴。此值不随语言变化。调大 → 拆分更少但译文行更长。
lblBiMaxW.en: Max width of the TRANSLATED line in bilingual export (same full-width unit, not characters: the same 32 is about 32 Chinese characters but about 64 Thai characters). Constrains the translated line only; the source line follows semantic breaks and is not width-limited, and dual-speaker lines use "Single-language width" above. Exceeding it is the only thing that splits the timeline. This value does NOT change per language. Larger = fewer splits but longer translated lines.

splitWarn.zh: {0} 条字幕过长被切成 {1} 条，时间轴随之拆分。把单语行宽调到 {2} 以上即可保留原时间轴。
splitWarn.en: {0} long lines were split into {1}, which breaks up the timing. Raise the line width to {2} or more to keep the original timing.

splitWarnBi.zh: {0} 条双语字幕过长被切成 {1} 条，时间轴随之拆分。把双语行宽调到 {2} 以上即可保留原时间轴。
splitWarnBi.en: {0} bilingual lines were too long and split into {1}, which breaks up the timing. Raise the bilingual line width to {2} or more to keep the original timing.

wrapTip.zh: 修改设置，无须重新翻译，可在编辑区查看单语字幕的折行效果。
wrapTip.en: No re-translation needed — the wrapping of the monolingual subtitles updates in the editor right away.

wrapTipBi.zh: 修改设置，无须重新翻译，可在编辑区查看双语字幕的折行效果。
wrapTipBi.en: No re-translation needed — the wrapping of the bilingual subtitles updates in the editor right away.

btnPost.zh: ↻ 仅后处理（折行/清提示词）

logReady.zh: 就绪。导入字幕或载入示例开始。
logReady.en: Ready. Import subtitles or load the sample.

gotClick.zh: 已收到「开始翻译」的请求，正在准备…

reqSent.zh: 第 {0} 批请求已发出（{1} 个句组），正在等待模型响应…
reqSent.en: Batch {0} request sent ({1} groups) — waiting for the model…

waitSec.zh: 已等待 {0} 秒，仍在等待模型的响应…
waitSec.en: Waited {0} s — still no reply from the model…

startT.zh: 开始整片翻译：{0} → {1}，共 {2} 条，每批约 {3} 字符。

allDone.zh: 全部完成：删除水词 {0} 条，并入 {1} 条，折行 {2} 条。
allDone.en: All done: {0} fillers removed, {1} merged, {2} wrapped.

postDone.zh: 后处理完成：清除提示词 + 折行（每条 ≤ {0} 字）。
postDone.en: Post-processing done: tags cleaned + wrapped (each line ≤ {0} units).

emptyRows.zh: 还没有字幕。左侧「导入」→ 选文件 / 粘贴 / 载入示例。
emptyRows.en: No subtitles yet. Import on the left → choose a file / paste / load sample.

tcEditTip.en: Edits flow straight into the export

langSame.zh: 源语言与目标语言相同（{0}），请选择不同的目标语言。
langSame.en: Source and target language are the same ({0}); choose a different target.

customNeed.zh: 已选“自定义”风格，请填写风格描述；或改选其他风格。
customNeed.en: "Custom" style needs a description; or pick another style.

degradeDemo.zh: API 模式缺少 Base URL / Key / 模型 → 已自动降级为【规则演练】。
degradeDemo.en: API mode missing Base URL / Key / Model → fell back to dry run.

demoNote.zh: 【规则演练】无翻译引擎：仅演示 句组划分 / 水词清空 / 按时长分配 / 折行。译文列保留源语句，仅用于查看规则效果。
demoNote.en: [Dry run] No translation engine: demonstrates sentence grouping / filler clearing / duration-based split / wrapping. The translation column keeps source text.

groupInfo.zh: 已按句子分组：{0} 个句组，其中 {1} 组跨多条字幕——短句组将合并为单条字幕，长句组按各条时长切分回填。
groupInfo.en: Grouped into {0} sentences; {1} span multiple cues — short groups merge into a single cue, long groups split back by duration.

mergeInfo.zh: 跨条句组 {0} 组：{1} 组已合并为单条字幕，其余 {2} 组按时长切分回填。
mergeInfo.en: Multi-cue groups: {0}; {1} merged into single cues, {2} split back by duration.

copyFail.zh: 复制失败，请改用下载按钮。
copyFail.en: Copy failed. Please use the download button.

errModalTitle.en: The AI model is temporarily unavailable

errModalBody.zh: 翻译已停止：模型服务没有响应，可能是网络不稳、服务繁忙或配置失效。可稍等几分钟再试，或在「翻译引擎」中切换自定义 API（可先用「测试连接」验证）。
errModalBody.en: Translation stopped: the model service is not responding — the network may be unstable, the service busy, or the configuration invalid. Wait a few minutes and retry, or switch to a custom API under "Translation engine" (verify with "Test connection" first).

errModalGo.zh: 自己设置翻译引擎设置

errNotCfg.zh: 管理员尚未配置默认模型，请改用自定义 API。
errNotCfg.en: The site admin has not configured a default model. Please use your own API instead.

errIpLimit.zh: 今日该 IP 的免费翻译额度（{0} 次请求）已用完，可填写自己的 API Key 继续使用。
errIpLimit.en: Today's free translation quota for this IP ({0} requests) is used up. Enter your own API key to continue.

errGlobalLimit.zh: 本站今日免费翻译总额度已用完，可填写自己的 API Key 继续使用。
errGlobalLimit.en: Today's site-wide free translation quota is used up. Enter your own API key to continue.

rateWait.zh: 遇到限流（429），等待 20 秒后重试…

ratePace.zh: 免费模型限流中，{0} 秒后继续…

heroTitle.en: Whatever your subtitles need, let AI handle it

heroSub.zh: 翻译、清洗、特效、格式转换、双语剥离、时间轴、乱码修复、提取文本——工具各干各的，想用哪个点哪个。免费 · 免注册 · 隐私安全
heroSub.en: Translate, clean up, style, convert, split bilingual, shift timings, fix garbled text, extract dialogue—each tool does its own job. Free · No sign-up · Private

whyTag.zh: ✦ WHY US · 为什么选我们

whyTitle.zh: 别人叫它「机翻」，我们叫它字幕级翻译

whySub.zh: 每一项能力，都为「压进视频就能用」而设计
whySub.en: Every capability is designed for “drop it into your video and it just works”

feat1D.zh: 译文严格贴合原字幕时间轴，一条对一条；需要合并拆分时按时长智能分配，绝不漂移、不串行。
feat1D.en: Translations follow the original cue timing one-to-one; merges and splits are distributed by duration — no drift, no shifting.

feat2D.zh: 翻译前自动提取专名与歧义词生成术语表，第 1 条和第 300 条译法保证一致；还能强制保留指定专名。
feat2D.en: Proper nouns and ambiguous words are extracted into a glossary before translating, so cue 1 and cue 300 stay consistent; force-keep any term you like.

feat3D.zh: 超过行宽自动按标点与词边界折行，符合 Netflix 各语言规范，绝不把单词劈成两半。
feat3D.en: Lines that exceed the width wrap at punctuation and word boundaries following Netflix language standards — never splitting a word in half.

feat4D.zh: 「嗯、啊、you know」自动清除，源字幕的听写错误一并修正——译文干净到可以直接压片。
feat4D.en: “Um, uh, you know” are cleaned automatically, and transcription errors in the source are fixed along the way — clean enough to burn straight in.

feat5D.zh: 原文译文双行、堆叠、分屏随意切换，还能导出 TXT 对照稿，字幕组级的花样全都有。
feat5D.en: Dual-line, stacked or top/bottom split — switch freely, export TXT side-by-side scripts, all the fansub-grade tricks.

feat6D.zh: 字幕在你的浏览器里处理，默认不经任何第三方服务器；API Key 只存在本机。
feat6D.en: Subtitles are processed in your browser and never touch third-party servers; API keys stay on your device.

aboutBody.zh: 随心字幕 AI 是一款开源的 AI 字幕翻译工具。我们相信好的字幕工具应该免费、干净、尊重隐私——不塞广告、不要注册、不动你的文件。欢迎自部署、提需求、一起打磨。
aboutBody.en: AI-SRTSub is an open-source AI subtitle translator. We believe a good subtitle tool should be free, clean and privacy-respecting — no ads, no sign-up, no touching your files. Self-host it, file requests, polish it together.

modSecSub.zh: 三个各自独立的字幕工具，各做各的事。用哪一个、什么时候用，看手上的活儿。
modSecSub.en: Three standalone subtitle tools, each with its own job. Use whichever one fits the task in front of you.

modTrLead.zh: 把一整份外文字幕翻成你的语言，顺手把时间轴和折行一起收拾好。
modTrLead.en: Turn a whole foreign subtitle file into your language — timeline and line breaks handled along the way.

modTrDo1.zh: 100 种语言互译，句级合并翻译后按时长回填
modTrDo1.en: 100 languages; sentences are merged, translated, then split back across the original timing

modTrDo2.zh: 自动折行、去口语水词、统一专名与术语
modTrDo2.en: Automatic line wrapping, filler-word removal, consistent names and terminology

modTrDo3.zh: 导出单语 / 双语，SRT / VTT / ASS / SBV / TXT
modTrDo3.en: Export single- or bilingual SRT / VTT / ASS / SBV / TXT

modTrFix.zh: 一整句话被切成好几条、翻出来对不上画面；译文字数爆掉一行放不下；同一个人名前后三种译法。
modTrFix.en: One sentence chopped across five cues so the translation never lines up; lines too long to fit; the same name translated three different ways.

modTrWho.zh: 追剧的人、字幕组、自媒体与本地化团队、外语学习者。
modTrWho.en: Series fans, subtitle groups, creators and localization teams, language learners.

modClLead.zh: 字幕拿到手先过一遍：广告、水印、听障提示这些脏东西一次剔干净。
modClLead.en: Run a subtitle through here first: ads, watermarks and SDH cues stripped in one pass.

modClDo1.zh: 13 条规则分四类，默认开 9 条，随手开关
modClDo1.en: 13 rules in four groups, 9 on by default, toggle any of them

modClDo2.zh: 去水印广告、听障提示、HTML 标签，修全大写与乱码
modClDo2.en: Strip watermarks, ads, SDH cues and HTML tags; fix all-caps and mojibake

modClDo3.zh: 逐条列出改了什么，可一条条还原，不动时间轴
modClDo3.en: Every change listed cue by cue and revertible — timing never moves

modClFix.zh: 下载来的字幕夹着「本字幕由 XX 字幕组提供」；整份全大写看得累；编码错乱一片方块字。
modClFix.en: Downloaded subs stuffed with "subtitles by group X"; a whole file in ALL CAPS; a screen of garbled boxes.

modClWho.zh: 拿到现成字幕想直接用的人、要批量整理素材的字幕组。
modClWho.en: Anyone who grabbed an existing subtitle and just wants it usable, plus groups batch-cleaning material.

modFxLead.zh: 双语合并 + 上样式：字体、颜色、描边、位置所见即所得，导出就能压片。
modFxLead.en: Merge two tracks, then style them: font, colour, outline and position, all WYSIWYG and ready to burn in.

modFxDo1.zh: 两份字幕合并成双语，或调整已有双语的顺序与样式
modFxDo1.en: Merge two files into bilingual, or restyle a bilingual file you already have

modFxDo2.zh: ASS 5 套 / VTT 6 套行业模板，样式槽逐项微调
modFxDo2.en: 5 ASS and 6 VTT industry presets, with per-value style slots to fine-tune

modFxDo3.zh: 实时预览 = 导出结果，时间轴也能就地精修与批量校正
modFxDo3.en: Live preview equals the exported file; the timeline can be tweaked in place or fixed in bulk

modFxFix.zh: 想做双语字幕却要手工对轨；ASS 参数改完看不到效果；导出来和预览对不上。
modFxFix.en: Bilingual subs that have to be aligned by hand; ASS values whose effect you cannot see; exports that do not match the preview.

modFxWho.zh: 要做双语或特效字幕的创作者、压制组、需要无障碍字幕的团队。
modFxWho.en: Creators making bilingual or styled subtitles, encoding groups, teams that need accessible captions.

tcTrD.zh: 100 种语言互译，自动配轴、自动折行

tcClD.zh: 去广告水印、听障提示，13 条规则可开关
tcClD.en: Strip ads, watermarks and SDH cues — 13 switchable rules

tcFxD.zh: 单语双语都能做特技：字体、颜色、描边、位置
tcFxD.en: Mono or bilingual: font, colour, outline, position

tcDlD.zh: RiseKol 下载器：视频、音频、字幕一起存到本地
tcDlD.en: RiseKol downloader: video, audio and subtitles to your disk

tcAsD.zh: 跨境投放素材：脚本、商品图、成片、字幕
tcAsD.en: Cross-border ad assets: scripts, product images, finished cuts, subtitles

detTrT.zh: 把一整份外文字幕，翻成你的语言
detTrT.en: Turn a whole foreign subtitle file into your language

detClT.zh: 字幕拿到手，先过一遍水
detClT.en: Subtitles off the web deserve a rinse first

detFxT.zh: 单语双语，都能做出片级特效
detFxT.en: Mono or bilingual — either way, ready for the screen

detDlT.zh: 看到想要的视频，直接存下来
detDlT.en: See a video you want? Save it right there

detTrL.zh: 选好目标语言丢进来，句级合并、术语统一、折行排版一次做完。译文严格贴合原时间轴，导出的时间轴一条都不漂。
detTrL.en: Pick your target language and drop the file in: sentence merging, glossary consistency and line wrapping all happen in one pass. The translation stays locked to the original timing — not a single cue drifts.

detClL.zh: 从网站扒下来的字幕总带着广告、水印和听障提示。13 条规则按需开关，改了什么逐条列给你看，还能一条条撤回——时间轴一动不动。
detClL.en: Scraped subtitles come with ads, watermarks and hearing-impaired tags. Thirteen rules you can switch on and off, every change listed line by line and undoable one at a time — the timing never moves.

detFxL.zh: 手上是一条单语字幕，还是已经排好的双语，都能在这里定型：字体、字号、颜色、描边、位置、边距逐项调，预览就是你导出拿到的那一份。
detFxL.en: Whether you start from a single track or an already-paired bilingual one, this is where it gets its final look: font, size, colour, outline, position and margins, tuned one by one. The preview is exactly what you export.

detDlL.zh: RiseKol 视频下载器：粘个链接就能把视频、音频和原文字幕存到本地。桌面客户端，macOS 与 Windows 都有。
detDlL.en: RiseKol video downloader: paste a link and save the video, audio and original subtitles to your machine. A desktop app for macOS and Windows.

detTr1.zh: 100 种语言互译，句级合并后按时长回填
detTr1.en: Translate between 100 languages; merged sentences are re-timed by duration

detTr2.zh: 自动提取专名生成术语表，全片译法一致
detTr2.en: Proper nouns are collected into a glossary, so the whole file stays consistent

detTr3.zh: 超长自动折行，按标点与词边界走，不劈词
detTr3.en: Long lines wrap at punctuation and word edges — no words split in half

detTr4.zh: 导出单语 / 双语，SRT / VTT / ASS / SBV / TXT
detTr4.en: Export mono or bilingual: SRT / VTT / ASS / SBV / TXT
